desert_slime:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original production low-resolution pixel-art enemy animation sprite sheet for a dark fantasy side-view RPG.
Style: match the project's newly made skeleton enemies: grounded old-school 16-bit dark-fantasy sprite art, dark brown-black 1-pixel contours, compact angular pixel clusters, weathered materials, about 40-64 logical pixels of body detail; enlarge those pixels crisply. NOT cute/chibi, not smooth digital painting, not vector, not 3D. Readable restrained colors with a small accent, not monochrome.
Output exactly SIX equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows = 24 individual full-character frames. Prefer a square 1536x1536 transparent canvas. Each frame remains inside its own cell with minimum 15% clear left/right padding, minimum 10% clear top padding, ground baseline at 88% cell height. Uniform character scale and camera in ALL 24 cells. Logical movement and limb articulation, not copies merely shifted. Six completely separate silhouettes per row; generous TRANSPARENT gutters between them. No part touches a neighboring frame, no cropping at canvas edges.
Consistent LEFT-facing three-quarter side view. TRUE TRANSPARENT background; no checkerboard pattern baked in, no floor, no cast shadow, no background, no labels/text/numbers/grid/borders. Full body and every tail/limb/weapon always visible.
ROWS top to bottom: 1 IDLE, 2 MOVE, 3 ATTACK, 4 DIE. Each row has exactly six ordered poses left to right. Idle/movement should loop smoothly. Attack starts ready, winds up, makes clear contact toward LEFT, follows through, recovers to ready pose. Death starts alive recoiling, visibly buckles/falls, settles on the same ground baseline, final frame a complete readable motionless corpse/remains. Keep early death frames full-bodied. All poses same individual, proportions, palette and equipment.

PRIMARY CHARACTER AND ACTION DETAILS:
One original SLIME monster (史萊姆). A squat irregular jade-green translucent gel mound with a dim icy cyan inner nucleus, two tiny dark predatory eye slits, pale celadon specular pixel highlights. Green and muted cyan, deep teal edge shadows, restrained two-family palette. Anatomically a slime, NO arms/legs, NO humanoid equipment, NO giant cartoon eyes or smile. Specks of brown sand trapped near its underside, but no detached decorative particles in other cells.
IDLE: six subtle breathing/gel pulses; SAME volume, squashes and bulges. MOVE: a coherent crawl/hop cycle, compress, stretch forward LEFT, lift/land, recover; base subtly changes contour. ATTACK: ready, compress backward, build a pointed gel lobe, thrust that lobe strongly LEFT from its own body, impact, retract to idle; all gel stays connected, no detached projectile. DIE: recoil, lose height, collapse, spread into a small low green gel puddle with nucleus dimming, then settled puddle. Preserve the slime's green identity through death.
Return only the clean 24-frame transparent pixel-art sheet.

PRIMARY CHARACTER AND ACTION DETAILS:
One original full-body GOBLIN (哥布林), lean hunched small humanoid with olive-green skin, long pointed ears, hooked nose, beady amber eyes, complete arms and two complete legs/feet. Worn brown leather vest, dusty ochre trousers, a small rust-red neck scarf and belt, dull iron short cleaver in right hand, empty left hand; no shield. Head/body proportions grounded, not a giant chibi head. Weathered green/brown with one restrained rust-red accent. Match the sprite scale/detail of the project's articulated skeleton warriors.
IDLE: breathing and small shoulder/ear motion, cleaver low. MOVE: a six-pose crouched walk with clearly alternating bent knees/feet and counter-swinging weapon. ATTACK: low ready, pull cleaver back, raise it, sharp chopping slash toward LEFT, follow-through, recover. DIE: recoil, knees buckle, pitch sideways, hit ground, cleaver and full body settle, final complete goblin corpse; no decapitation or graphic gore.
Return only the clean 24-frame transparent pixel-art sheet.

PRIMARY CHARACTER AND ACTION DETAILS:
One original full-body WILD WOLF (野狼), a natural predatory quadruped, slender strong four-legged anatomy, a complete long bushy tail, angular grey-tawny fur, pale beige muzzle/throat/underside, desaturated slate-blue shadow along back, tiny pale icy eyes. Restrained grey-brown/slate color families. NO clothes, weapons, collars, armor, human hands or humanoid pose; not a puppy, not a fox, not a giant boss. LEFT-facing three-quarter side view; four leg anatomy readable with front/back limb offsets; all paws and tail fit fully in every cell. Need generous lateral padding for tail and pouncing snout.
IDLE: alert breathing, ears and tail slightly moving. MOVE: six articulated walking/trotting poses with alternating forelegs and hindlegs, real joint changes. ATTACK: standing ready, lower hindquarters, neck draws back, short forward LEFT pounce and open-jaw bite, jaws close/follow through, land and recover to ready. Keep its position near its own cell anchor, no traveling across cells. DIE: flinch, front legs buckle, roll to side, lie down, tail and paws settle, complete motionless wolf corpse; no graphic gore.
Return only the clean 24-frame transparent pixel-art sheet.

PRIMARY CHARACTER AND ACTION DETAILS:
One original full-body DESERT SKELETON SOLDIER (骷髏兵), match the recently created skeleton warriors' weathered ivory/ochre skull and bones, hollow dark eye sockets, thin neck, ribcage, spine, pelvis, TWO complete articulated legs and TWO feet. A distinct desert infantry variation: small battered open-face bronze skullcap, short tattered muted turquoise/verdigris waist cloth and shoulder scrap, brown leather belt, a rusty curved short scimitar in right hand and a small plain weathered bronze buckler in the left. Ivory bones, brown leather, dull bronze and restrained faded turquoise accent. Sparse equipment keeps most bones visible. Not a recolor of the earlier red shield or green axe soldiers; new skullcap/cloth/scimitar silhouette. All equipment stays attached in alive poses.
IDLE: subtle skull/shoulder breathing, scimitar down, buckler near ribs. MOVE: six-pose complete leg/joint walking cycle, knees and ankles alternate, weapon counter-swing. ATTACK: ready, withdraw sword, shoulder rotates, curved scimitar slashes decisively LEFT, follow through, recover; buckler on opposite arm. DIE: recoil, knees buckle, fall sideways, bones and scimitar land, skeleton settles into a low corpse, final full skeletal remains with helmet/buckler/weapon near same foot baseline, not six skull-only frames.
Return only the clean 24-frame transparent pixel-art sheet.
